newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovakia revises upward 1996 sugar beet crop.
newsitem.headline: Slovakia revises upward 1996 sugar beet crop.

text.p: The Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) on Tuesday said it had revised slightly upwards its 1996 sugar beet crop forecast to 1.65-1.72 million tonnes, from a previous estimate of 1.60-1.65 million tonnes.
SUSR added that this year's yield per hectare should rise to 39.54 tonnes according to the latest test of October 15, from 38.14 tonnes forecast on September 15.
SUSR said the higher crop forecast, due to more favourable weather, represented a 43.1 percent increase over the sugar beet crop in 1995.
Sown area rose by 22.1 percent to 42,600 hectares in 1996 from 34,900 hectares in 1995, the bureau said, adding that 34,335 hectares were actually harvested last year.
It did not give an estimate of expected harvested area for 1996. No percentage of sugar content per beet forecast was immediately available.
Slovakia's 1995 sugar beet crop was 1.176 million tonnes, with the yield per hectare of 34.26 tonnes.
